_comment: Hypothesis test: SVS MaxPipelineSize=10 (production default) on rocketfuel_1755 at bw=10 Mbps. Baseline has pipeline=20 and sub-linear FIB. If pipeline size contributes, reducing to 10 should partially or fully fix convergence. Run with: sudo ./jobs.sh start --fresh prefix_scale/rocketfuel_1755_onephase_pipeline10_3stage
name: rocketfuel_1755_onephase_pipeline10_3stage
description: rocketfuel_1755 onephase at bw=10 Mbps with SVS pipeline=10 (vs baseline pipeline=20). Tests whether MaxPipelineSize contributes to congestion-driven FIB sub-linearity.

jobs.name: stage1: DV convergence snapshot (onephase, 0 prefixes, bw=10)
stage2: onephase prefix table measurement p0 (import DV snap, bw=10, pipeline=10)
stage2: onephase prefix table measurement p2000 (import DV snap, bw=10, pipeline=10)
